purpose: Audited expected configuration of the operator-issued existing-human activation flow; not public enrollment or automatic token issuance
guardExpression:
ctx = request.context
plan = ctx.get("flow_plan")
if plan is not None:
    ctx = plan.context
user = ctx.get("pending_user")
token = ctx.get("is_restored")
return bool(user and token and user.is_active and not user.is_superuser and getattr(token, "user_id", None) == user.pk and not user.groups.filter(name="homelab-owner").exists())
